asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

duration.description:
The duration of the toast.
By default, it is determined by the type of the toast.

hotkey.description: The hotkey that will move focus to the toast group

max.description: The maximum number of toasts. When the number of toasts exceeds this limit, the new toasts are queued.

offsets.description: The offset from the safe environment edge of the viewport

pauseOnPageIdle.description: Whether to pause toast when the user leaves the browser tab

removeDelay.description:
The duration for the toast to kept alive before it is removed.
Useful for exit transitions.
